Record Class ProvenanceRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.ai.agentic.ProvenanceRecord
Record Components:
phase - producing phase
seedHash - seed hash at the time of the record
decision - human-readable decision or outcome
commands - commands considered or executed (never applied from model authority)
artifacts - artifact paths or logical names
deniedMutations - audited denial reasons for trust-boundary attempts
public record ProvenanceRecord(AgenticPhase phase, String seedHash, String decision, List<String> commands, List<String> artifacts, List<String> deniedMutations) extends Record
One inspectable provenance entry (FR-3).

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
